messages.subject: R818 source-only typed BF16 QSA proposal ready
messages.body: I prepared /home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl/bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/own-native16-qsa-integration-v1 (198135 bytes; payload SHA256 4a403f02e28720b0ce80697250ee50722b298c2a12b1de2a74f0544fe89fecc6; patch SHA256 f91dc390a6a69e19f79ef084c0d859f5dad62f90e32969a9fe0ce565fc804e2b), with exact current source hashes, MIT provenance and independent fixtures. The proposal wires direct BF16 Q/K/V outputs, fused norm/RoPE/split, device Q8 append, the unchanged reviewed R787 attention core and typed gate/output consumers; v1 requires resident unrotated INT8, text/session RoPE tables and Mode1/Mapping0, with full registered allocation checks and original FP32/indexer/GDN/residual callbacks and scratch reservations preserved. Compilation, tests, numerical/model quality, GPU faults, physical262144, RESTORE and performance are all UNRUN, so Main must review and qualify the patch with an independently qualified GEMM backend only after the current cohorts close.
